title: Version Changelog - 2023
body_markdown:
[Link to Changelog - 2024](https://wiki.heptabase.com/changelog/2024)


## v1.18.1​


*Decomber 29, 2023*


- Allow users to batch modify the due date of multiple todo items from the block menu.
- Allow users to use Option/Alt + Click to open the linked card in the backlink info to the right sidebar.
- Adjusted the keyboard shortcut to toggle the right sidebar.
- Fixed an issue where the app may hang when editing the hyperlink of the selected texts.
- Fixed an issue where users couldn’t perform Cmd/Ctrl + F search in the right sidebar.
- Fixed an issue where users may fail to locate a PDF highlight from the Highlights right sidebar


## v1.18.0​


*December 24, 2023*


- Right Sidebar: Search and add cards and web elements from the search bar


- Whiteboard: Upgrade the right sidebar to support the display and operation of multiple items


- App: Highlight Card Filter and Action


- Auto scroll when dragging a kanban card, a table row, a tag, or a tag group near an edge
- Improved overall back and forward navigation experiences
- Fixed an issue where restoring sync history from the web version may cause some images not display
- Fixed an issue where images may fail to download under certain network environment


## Mobile App v1.11.0​


*December 24, 2023*


- App: Highlight Card


## v1.17.3​


*December 8, 2023*


- Improve the overall performance when editing mindmap texts.
- Hide untitled sections when using global search and mention search.
- Fixed an issue where connection description field in shared whiteboard may shift in mobile devices.
- Fixed an issue where importing would fail in certain situations.
- Fixed an issue where clicking "Today" on the journal page may behave incorrectly after midnight.
- Fixed an issue where inline math may not align center in bullet lists.
- Fixed an issue where the Heptabase window may move unexpectedly in some Windows devices.
- Fixed an issue where users may not be able to select texts in shared whiteboards.
- Fixed an issue where some users may encounter bugs related to highlights in certain situations.


## Mobile App v1.10.3​


*December 5, 2023*


- Fixed an issue where typing Chinese characters in manage tag search would fail.


## Mobile App v1.10.2​


*December 2, 2023*


- Support managing tags in cards, PDF cards, and journal cards.
- Fixed an issue where the todo block would have extra spacing on the right.


## v1.17.2​


*December 2, 2023*


- Fixed an issue where creating a new tag in the desktop app may cause the tag's table view to display incorrectly in certain situations.


## v1.17.1​


*November 28, 2023*


- Fixed an issue where attempting to split or edit larger mindmaps in certain situations would cause the content of the mindmap to disappear.
- Fixed an issue where creating a card from a list block would falsely display the card title.


## v1.17.0​


*November 27, 2023*


- Journal: Allow users to move tasks to another date when rescheduling them in the Journal.


- Allow users to click on empty space to deselect the todo item in the task app.
- Fixed an issue where users who only have Readwise highlights may not see the Highlight app correctly.
- Fixed an issue where adding highlights to a whiteboard may result in duplicated highlights.
- Fixed an issue where some mindmap nodes could not be deleted in certain situations.
- Fixed an issue where clicking a button in the floating menu in the task app would cause the editor to lose focus.


## Mobile App v1.10.1​


*November 23, 2023*


- Fixed an issue where users cannot paste a URL into the editor from Safari.
- Fixed an issue where the sync might stop at pending state in certain situations.


## v1.16.2​


*November 22, 2023*


- Fixed an issue where the app would be unresponsive during file downloads.
- Fixed an issue where new devices were unable to sync files.
- Fixed an issue where file downloads would fail in certain situations.


## v1.16.1​


*November 21, 2023*


- Fixed an issue where the image in web app may not load correctly in certain situations.
- Fixed an issue where users cannot paste a URL into the editor from Safari.
- Fixed an issue where the drag handle was difficult to detect in the new todo block
- Fixed an issue where todo block would be duplicated when dragged and dropped


## v1.16.0​


*November 20, 2023*


- Task App: Todo grouping, assign due dates


- App: Journal Card Filter and Action


- Introduces a mechanism for handling sync conflicts.
- Recognizes backlinks in markdown titles during import.
- Fixed an issue where using the "paste and match style" shortcut could cause duplication in Windows and Linux.
- Fixed an issue where importing images could fail in certain situations.
- Fixed an issue where downloading large files from cloud would use too much memory and cause crash.
- Fixed an issue where users would not be locked in the highlight position within a PDF under certain circumstances.


## Mobile App v1.10.0​


*November 20, 2023*


- Displays tags and properties in a journal card info
- Improved the resolution of conflicting syncing on card and journal.
- Fixed an issue where the floating keyboard on iPad would not display correctly.


## v1.15.2​


*November 15, 2023*


- Adds the option to include frontmatter and download files when importing from Obsidian and Roam Research.
- Shows the active block in the "turn into" block menu.
- Fixed an issue where using the paste and match style shortcut could conflict with other clipboard management tools.
- Fixed an issue where clicking a link in mind map text node may causes reloading of the app.
- Fixed an issue where typing @ will trigger mention menu incorrectly.
- Fixed an issue where copying and pasting text from Word resulted in an image.
- Fixed an issue where the background of in app browsing may be incorrect in some webpages.
- Removed the shortcut for making texts bold by double underscore.


## v1.15.1​


*November 10, 2023*


- Support copying as Markdown in the block menu.
- Fixed an issue where using the paste and match style shortcut may trigger the pasting action globally.
- Fixed an issue where sometimes the highlight selected text shortcut may fail to work.
- Fixed the path undefined error during import.
- Fixed an issue where journals may be recognized in the tag's table when importing.
- Fixed an issue where task status are not updated in the web app.
- Fixed an issue where wiki links with accents may not be recognized during import.


## v1.15.0​


*November 7, 2023*


- Task App: Display all to-dos across Heptabase.


- Whiteboard: Paste content as text elements.


- Added a shortcut (Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + v) to paste and match style.
- Improved overall import experience.
- Allowed importing zip files and individual files via Markdown/Text import.
- Allowed importing Roam Research and Logseq graphs into Heptabase (beta).
- Allowed importing Notion pages into Heptabase (beta)
- Fixed an issue where importing did not preserve the space between text and internal link.
- Fixed an issue where only partial cards were imported via Obsidian import.
- Removed the frame on the application window in Mac.


## v1.14.0​


*November 1, 2023*


- Card Library: Filter Bar Upgrade
- Added a shortcut to create text elements (Cmd/Ctrl + Double-click).
- Allowed users to press Enter to open a whiteboard and confirm deleting cards.
- Improved performance of the whiteboard when there are only a few objects in the visible area.
- Enhanced usability of the shared whiteboard on mobile devices.
- Fixed an issue where users could unintentionally trigger whiteboard object previews while editing in the right sidebar.
- Fixed an issue that prevented users from switching the PDF card reference in the card tab.
- Fixed an issue where the user did not have a default tab group upon entering the app.
- Fixed an issue where the user could encounter file corruption when exporting files.


## Mobile App v1.9.0​


*October 31, 2023*


- Improved loading speed and smoother dragging of the whiteboard


## v1.13.0​


*October 29, 2023*


- Left Sidebar: Pin tabs, tab group, tab folder, clear tabs, etc.


- When pasting multiple card links into a list block, they will all be converted into list items.
- Fixed an issue where certain users were unable to synchronize tag groups correctly.
- Fixed an issue where turning a block into a code block would always set the default language as JavaScript.
- Fixed an issue where publishing a whiteboard could cause linked whiteboards to disappear.
- Fixed an issue where YouTube embeds did not respect the start timestamp.


## Mobile App v1.8.0​


*October 29, 2023*


- Improved the loading speed of whiteboard pages.
- Fixed an issue where uploading images in in-app support may fail in some devices


## v1.12.2​


*October 23, 2023*


- Adjusted the contrast of the scrollbar in dark mode.
- Fixed an issue where key strokes would unintentionally affect unselected objects in certain situations.
- Removed the inaccurate clicking area of the toggle list.


## v1.12.1​


*October 20, 2023*


- Support copying and pasting files into a whiteboard to create media elements.
- Support keyboard navigation in the shared whiteboard.
- Fixed an issue where pasting images from other websites would cause the loss of their filename extensions.
- Fixed an issue where some users failed to change list formats.
- Fixed an issue where focus mode persisted when opening a card in a new tab.


## v1.12.0​


*October 17, 2023*


- Whiteboard: Audio & Video Elements


- Whiteboard: Focus Mode


- Added a feature that allows users to log out from all devices.
- Fixed an issue where the connection menu would persist in certain situations.
- Fixed an issue where the highlight color was not displayed correctly in global search, embeds, and quick look.
- Fixed an issue where the layout could be disrupted in certain situations due to space-out function.
- Fixed an issue where users with a specific network card failed to sync.


## Mobile App v1.7.0​


*October 17, 2023*


- Support audio and video element on whiteboard.
- Fixed an issue where the tag's card list would showing errors for certain tags.


## Mobile App v1.6.1​


*October 11, 2023*


- Added turn into menu in the editor toolbar.
- Added an option to set theme to system mode.
- Added bug report & submit feedback in the setting screen.
- Fixed an issue where reading mobile whiteboard may trigger spacing out unexpectedly.
- Fixed an issue where some users saw empty result in tag’s card list screen.
- Fixed an issue where the layout in mobile app was different from desktop app’s.
- Android: Fixed an issue where pressing enter would not add a new bullet in the next line.
- Android: Fixed an issue where it was unable to change to landscape orientation.


## Mobile App v1.6.0​


*October 5, 2023*


- Added card info: see backlinks, whiteboards, tags, and properties at a glance.


- Fixed an issue where the card library shows empty results on certain devices.


## v1.11.0​


*October 2, 2023*


- Whiteboard: Image Elements


- App: Better Export for tags, properties, and mindmaps


## Mobile App v1.5.0​


*October 2, 2023*


- Support image element in whiteboards.


## v1.10.1​


*September 29, 2023*


- Displayed a toolbar when hovering over a highlight element.
- Fixed an issue where some users experienced unexpected layout shift in the whiteboard.
- Fixed an issue where the image of pdf area highlight does not show after syncing process finished.
- Fixed an issue where under certain situations a default backup location would not be assigned.


## Mobile App v1.4.0​


*September 29, 2023*


- Introduce a new home tab — access card library, whiteboard, tag, and highlights all at once!


- Added recent access to the search tab when no keyword is present.
- Improved keyboard display logic on pages with a search input.
- Fixed an issue where connections are not synced properly in the mobile app.
- Fixed an issue that may cause an invalid result when the size of a single card is more than 2MB.
- Fixed an upgrade issue when there is invalid data.
- Fixed the highlight color shown in the highlight content page.


## v1.10.0​


*September 26, 2023*


- Highlight: Sort and Color ( *Currently, we sort readwise highlights based on the highlight orders provided by readwise.* )


- Allow users to find deleted cards in the trash when undoing the creation of cards
- Fixed an issue where a deleted mindmap card node couldn't be removed from a whiteboard
- Fixed an issue where the app may freeze when users have lots of highlight elements


## Mobile App v1.3.0​


*September 26, 2023*


- Added highlight color on PDF Cards.
- Added clicking to view the highlight content in PDF Cards.


## Mobile App v1.2.5​


*September 23, 2023*


- Added the page to see highlight content from search.
- Added a button to the editor menu for attaching media to the editor quickly.
- Added an option to delete a card from the card context menu.
- Fixed an issue where typing in Chinese sometimes resulted in broken words sometimes.
- Fixed the background color of keyboard in dark mode.


## v1.9.0​


*September 20, 2023*


- Fixed an issue where certain users couldn't open the app.
- Fixed an issue where duplicate placeholders were displayed when the image failed to load.


## v1.8.0​


*September 19, 2023*


- [App: Built-in Customer Support](https://support.heptabase.com/en/articles/10448156-how-can-i-contact-heptabase-support)


- Allow users to subscribe directly and start onboarding on the web app.
- Fixed an issue where context menu icon in journal toolbar may be hidden in some screen width in journal app


## Mobile App v1.2.4​


*September 18, 2023*


- Added block search results.


- Fixed an issue where opening a card would result in a white transition screen in dark mode.
- Fixed an issue where a PDF card would display a blank page on some devices.
- Fixed an issue where the text of a PDF card was not rendered properly for certain languages.
- Fixed an issue where the cursor in the editor would sometimes be overlapped by the editor menu.
- Fixed an issue where pressing the enter key would not automatically scroll if the cursor was not visible.
- Fixed an issue where the "more" button on the math block appeared at the top of a card.
- Fixed an issue where the journal may enter a loading state indefinitely after a period of inactivity.


## Mobile App v1.2.3​


*September 14, 2023*


- Editor:[Version History](https://support.heptabase.com/en/articles/10448124-how-to-restore-my-cards-and-whiteboards-from-version-history)


## v1.5.0​


*September 13, 2023*


- Allow users to select a whiteboard object by single-clicking on its toolbar.
- Fixed an issue where spacing out a parent section would also space out the inner section.


## Mobile App v1.2.2​


*September 11, 2023*


- Fixed an issue where tag's card list would crash if there were PDF cards.
- Fixed an issue where file syncing may unexpectedly re-upload files.


## v1.4.0​


*September 11, 2023*


- Whiteboard: Quick look a whiteboard object by pressing space key


## Mobile App v1.2.1​


*September 9, 2023*


- Fixed an issue where new cards created on desktop were not syncing immediately to the mobile app.
- Fixed an issue where deletion operations were not syncing to the mobile app.
- Fixed an issue where users with many cards may only see PDF cards instead of all cards in the card library.


## Mobile App v1.2​


*September 6, 2023*


- Improve the overall app performance.


- Fixed an issue that sometimes cloud sync stops working but the status is still synced.
- Fixed an issue that journal becomes blank page.
- Fixed an issue that users may get stuck on the loading screen.
- Fixed the incorrect theme color in Android when system default color is dark mode.
- Added a dialog when user uses the app before using the desktop app.


## v1.0.0​


*August 31, 2023*


👉 See[Heptabase 1.0](https://wiki.heptabase.com/version-one) for detailed information about this update!


- App: Free Trial and New Pricing
- PDF Reader Upgrade


- Removed Timeline mode in Card Library


## Mobile App v1.1.3​


*August 30, 2023*


- Fixed an issue that opening a card may have extra blank line on the top of content when the card contains toggle list.
- Fixed Android 10 and 11 compatibility issue.
- Fixed an issue that may cause Android out-of-memory during uploading file.
- Fixed an issue that search will return no result when there are multiple CJK characters.


## v0.373.0​


*August 30, 2023*


- Renamed the app from Hepta to Heptabase.
- Fixed an issue where typing could be slow when there are numerous links in a card or a journal.
- Fixed an issue where lists could not be un-toggled in backlinks and shared whiteboards.
- Fixed an issue where dragging a whiteboard into another whiteboard failed in the Map.
- Fixed an issue that caused adding a tag to a new card to be laggy.


## v0.371.0​


*August 28, 2023*


- Whiteboard: Keyboard Navigation


- Allow users to snap objects to mindmap nodes
- Automatically select matching tags when adding a tag to a card
- Fixed an issue where the "Settings" menu would be duplicated in certain situations
- Press Cmd/Ctrl + Arrow to zoom in/out a whiteboard


## v0.369.1​


*August 23, 2023*


- Whiteboard: Section Auto-grow & Card Space-out


- Allow users to delete highlights from a deleted PDF source.
- Fixed an issue where users were unable to copy text from a PDF using CMD + C.
- Fixed an issue where the description between two merged elbow lines would disappear.
- Fixed an issue where elbow connections would stick when moving cards.
- Fixed a display issue where the Highlight card showed redundant spaces.
- Fixed a bug where users were unable to select the first character of a single-line text element.


## v0.368.0​


*August 21, 2023*


- Fixed: When highlighting on continuous PDF pages, there will be duplicate highlights.
- Fixed: When using the "a" shortcut in the PDF area highlight, the "a" will be included in the annotation area.
- Fixed: Removed the constraint for the journal editor in the journal panel.


## v0.367.1​


*August 19, 2023*


- Allow users to open Settings directly from the top of the left sidebar.
- Add a new In-app Help button.
- Add new Tutorial and Slides.
- Change the name "project-meta" to "Hepta" in the About menu.
- Fixed: Unable to log in with Safari & Firefox in some cases.


## v0.363.1​


*August 13, 2023*


- Support pressing Enter to confirm a dialog.
- Fixed: Incorrectly pasted whiteboard objects after copying images from other places.
- Fixed: Incorrectly closed left sidebar when pressing` Cmd` +` Option` +` \\`


.
- Fixed: Modified the position when creating an object on a whiteboard.


## v0.360.0​


*August 9, 2023*


- Fixed: Show the mention connections.


## v0.359.0​


*August 9, 2023*


- *Classic timeline will be going away in August. See[journal use case](https://wiki.heptabase.com/a-simple-method-to-convert-your-thinking-into-writing) .*
- Support zooming in whiteboard on mobile devices
- Fixed: Correct the number symbol order on nested number lists


## v0.358.0 - Whiteboard: Connect mindmap node to anything​


*August 8, 2023*


- Whiteboard: Connect mindmap node to anything


## v0.356.0​


*August 2, 2023*


- Change the color of a mindmap text node.
- Move "Heading n" forward in search rankings.
- Prevent the slash menu from opening due to repositioning when closing it.
- Add the tooltip for opening in new tab.
- Change the default width for turning a text node into a card node.
- Fix incorrect result of section search when section title contains CJK characters.
- Fix blank preview of card on mind map in whiteboard search (web/desktop).
- Fix number list starting number issue when number lists are in table cells.
- Fix export as markdown format issue when table cell is empty.
- Fix global search may lead to crashing issue (desktop only).
- Prevent from blocking the sync history panel.
- Allow to proceed to the next step when a tutorial video ends.


## v0.354.0​


*July 31, 2023*


- Feature: Open card(s) in a new tab using` Cmd/Ctrl` +` Enter`


.
- Feature: Fold card(s) on a whiteboard using` Cmd/Ctrl` +` Option/Shift` +` Enter`


.
- Improvement: Alert before deleting a mind map.
- Improvement: Add a card to the current center position of a whiteboard using` Cmd` +` O`


and then` Shift` +` Enter`


.
- Fixed: False alert issue of "changes not saved."


## v0.352.0​


*July 27, 2023*


- Improved: New Onboarding data
- Improved: Performance of dragging cards into sections
- Fixed: Shaking issue with Mindmap card nodes containing images


## v0.350.2​


*July 26, 2023*


- App: Design System Upgrade - Command Palette


## v0.349.2​


*July 22, 2023*


- Fixed unclickable code block and math input.


## v0.349.1​


*July 20, 2023*


- App: Design System Upgrade - Menus

*July 17, 2023*


- Whiteboard: Arrow Elbow Curve


## v0.344.0​


*July 16, 2023*


- App: Search Engine Upgrade for Card Library / Highlight
- Improved: Update design system (partial).
- Improved: Editor performance for using mention menu.


## v0.342.0​


*July 11, 2023*


- App: Search Engine Upgrade for Mention Menu / Split Panel
- Whiteboard: Remember arrow style preference
- Whiteboard: Better arrow control point detection
- Whiteboard: Better arrow curvature
- Fix: set the correct resized height of a text element


## v0.338.0​


*July 8, 2023*


- Whiteboard: Expanded card in mindmap


## v0.336.0​


*July 7, 2023*


- Whiteboard: Arrow Line Style, Head Style, Color


## **v0.333.1**​


*July 5, 2023*


- App: Search Engine Upgrade for` Cmd` +` O`


/` Cmd` +` P`

*July 1, 2023*


- Whiteboard: Custom Arrow Control Point


## v0.329.0​


*June 28, 2023*


- Prevent potential data loss.


## v0.328.0​


*June 26, 2023*


- Mindmap: improve the drag & drop experience.


## v0.327.0​


*June 22, 2023*


- App: Better Drag & Drop for working tab
- Tag: Drag & Drop for rearranging views


## v0.325.1​


*June 16, 2023*


- Mindmap: Improve performance while editing a text node.
- Mindmap: Support undo/redo for the operations across mindmaps.
- Mindmap: prevent the potential data loss during undo/redo.
- Editor: Re-render the Mermaid output as code block changes.


## v0.324.2​


*June 14, 2023*


- Fixed: Resolved the issue of getting stuck at core upgrade when users are upgrading from a very old version.
- Fixed: Resolved the issue of can’t create numbered list start with arbritary number.


## v0.324.0​


*June 12, 2023*


- Editor: Increase file upload limit to 2GB per file.
- Fixed: Do not display floating menu when selecting code block.
- Fixed: Resolve issue with inability to type Chinese characters in code block.


## v0.323.2​


*June 10, 2023*


- Editor: Improved the style of invalid embed blocks and made them selectable by click.
- Editor: Do not show the drop cursor within currently selected blocks.
- Editor: Do not show a scrollbar for an auto-fit table in a list's nested block.
- Editor: Polished the failed to load image placeholder.
- Editor: Fixed an issue where the caret would sometimes appear even when a block is selected.
- Editor: Fixed the issue that caused the split panel to close when closing the image popup with the Escape key.
- Editor: Fixed the incorrect block selection when using` Shift` + click to select a range of blocks.
- Highlight: Fixed an issue where the mention node in the highlight app could not be opened.
- Editor: Fixed the issue where the drag handle for a quote block with heading 1 inside could not be used.
- Editor: Fixed the issue where the caret position would be reset in a code block when switching between windows.
- Editor: Fixed the issue where using the Escape key inside a code block could not select the block.
- Editor: Fixed the issue where editing in the whiteboard with split may crash in some edge cases.


## v0.322.1​


*June 9, 2023*


- Editor: Media Block Improvement
- Drag & drop


- Improved: Made the detection of dropping a card/journal/highlight instance as an embed in the whiteboard more accurate and prevented a failed drop.
- Improved: The drop cursor at the very beginning in card instances is not partially hidden by the instance topbar.
- Improved: It is easier to drop after the last block as we extend the detectable drop area.
- Fixed: Resolved the issue where dropping files would fail when dropping at a code or math block.
- Fixed: Resolved the issue where dropping blocks would fail when the cursor is on the last child of a block.
- Fixed: Resolved the issue where sometimes using the drag handle would drag a wrong block nearby.
- Fixed: Resolved the incorrect drag handle location when there are long mention nodes in the list item.
- Fixed: Resolved the issue where dropping PDF files on media, embed, and code blocks would incorrectly add a PDF card instance on the whiteboard.


- Other improvements


- Improved: When the height of a card instance is larger than that of the content, all areas inside the instance can still trigger editing.
- Improved: Polished the to-do and toggle list style.
- Improved: Corrected the hovering background color on the toolbar of media blocks.
- Fixed: Resolved the issue where in some cases, the sync status light would be green even when offline.
- Fixed: Resolved the issue where upgrading from a version older than 0.240.2 may fail.

*June 6, 2023*


- Whiteboard: Adjust highlight element height
- Editor: Card Info redesign
- Tag: Date, Phone, Email Property

- Fixed: do not trigger numbered list transforming when typing english letters.

*June 4, 2023*

- Editor: List Upgrade

*May 25, 2023*


- App: Database migration

## v0.310.2​


*May 22, 2023*


- Whiteboard: Mindmap
- Editor: List Improvement


- Feature: Use` Cmd` +` Enter`


shortcut to toggle todo list, bullet list, and toggle list.
- Improved: Clicking on a bullet or todo will toggle the state of all selected items.
- Improved: Checked Todo items in a Todo list should have a strikethrough and grey color.
- Fixed: Using` Alt` +` Up/Down`


arrow keys in a Todo List will not delete the Todo item.
- Fixed: Pressing Enter to create a new line in a checked Todo item should not uncheck it.
- Fixed: Corrected the incorrect highlight element backlink information in the card info.
- Fixed: Removed the strange resizing animation of the image block in the table cell.

*May 21, 2023*


- Tag: Text Property Improvement
- Improved: Show embedded highlights in shared whiteboard.
- Improved: Show title of mentioned links in shared whiteboard.

*May 18, 2023*


- App: Markdown Export Improvement
- Fix the mention link text not displayed on card title.
- Fix the width of the right sidebar when creating cards with a long title.
- Fix the incorrect size of the whiteboard object when selecting it.

*May 16, 2023*


- Fixed: can’t display sidebar

- Tag: Grouping & Entry Page Redesign

*May 5, 2023*


- Fixed the bug in a new database

*April 28, 2023*

- Editor: Selection Improvement

- Feature: Editor: Mermaid diagram in code blocks

## v0.291.2 - Editor: Embed Highlight​


*April 8, 2023*


- Editor: Embed Highlight
- Support for dragging blocks into text elements.
